summary_ja: 事業法人等向け及びリテール向けエクスポージャーの期待損失額の算出方法(PD×LGD×EAD、スロッティング・クライテリアの場合のリスク・ウェイト×八パーセント×EAD等)を定める。
summary_en: Defines the expected loss amount: PD x LGD x EAD in general, EAD x risk weight x 8% for slotted specialized lending, with mutatis mutandis rules for credit derivatives and zero for other exposures.
paragraphs: The expected loss amount of corporate, etc. exposures (excluding specialized lending assigned to the slotting criteria under Article 129, paragraphs (4) and (6)) and retail exposures shall be the amount obtained by multiplying the PD, LGD and EAD of the exposure; provided, however, that in the case of default, it shall be the amount obtained by multiplying EL_{default} provided in Article 194, paragraph (6) by EAD.

For specialized lending under Article 129, paragraph (4), excluding high-volatility commercial real estate lending assigned to the slotting criteria, the expected loss amount shall be the amount obtained by multiplying the EAD of the exposure by the risk weight listed in the following table and by 8%; provided, however, that in accordance with the proviso to that paragraph, a risk weight of 0% shall be applied to an exposure assigned to Strong and to which a risk weight of 50% was applied, and a risk weight of 5% to an exposure assigned to Good and to which a risk weight of 70% was applied. {{T:p157t0}}

For high-volatility commercial real estate lending assigned to the slotting criteria under Article 129, paragraph (6), the expected loss amount shall be the amount obtained by multiplying the EAD of the exposure by the risk weight listed in the following table and by 8%. {{T:p158t0}}

The provisions of Article 112 shall apply mutatis mutandis where the expected loss amount is calculated under the preceding three paragraphs. In this case, the term "Ultimate Designated Parent Company adopting the standardized approach" in that Article shall be read as "Ultimate Designated Parent Company adopting the internal ratings-based approach", and the phrase "summing the risk weights up to a maximum of 1,250%, and multiplying the credit equivalent amount of that credit derivative by that risk weight, to calculate the amount of credit risk-weighted assets" shall be read as "summing the amounts obtained by multiplying PD and LGD up to a maximum of 100%, and multiplying the result by the EAD of that credit derivative, to calculate the expected loss amount".

The provisions of Article 114 shall apply mutatis mutandis where the expected loss amount is calculated under paragraphs (1) through (4). In this case, the term "Article 112" in that Article shall be read as "Article 112 as applied mutatis mutandis with replacement of terms under Article 126, paragraph (4)", "Ultimate Designated Parent Company adopting the standardized approach" as "Ultimate Designated Parent Company adopting the internal ratings-based approach", "shall calculate the amount of credit risk-weighted assets" as "shall calculate", and "the amount of credit risk-weighted assets reduced for the single exposure whose credit risk-weighted assets are reduced least when the risk weight of the protection provider is applied up to the notional principal amount of that credit derivative may be deducted" as "the expected loss amount reduced for the single exposure whose credit risk-weighted assets are reduced least when the required capital ratio of the protection provider is applied up to the EAD of that credit derivative may be deducted".

The provisions of Article 115 shall apply mutatis mutandis where the expected loss amount is calculated under paragraphs (1) through (4). In this case, the term "Article 112" in that Article shall be read as "Article 112 as applied mutatis mutandis with replacement of terms under Article 126, paragraph (4)", "Ultimate Designated Parent Company adopting the standardized approach" as "Ultimate Designated Parent Company adopting the internal ratings-based approach", "shall calculate the amount of credit risk-weighted assets" as "shall calculate", and "the total amount of credit risk-weighted assets reduced for the exposures, counting from the single exposure whose credit risk-weighted assets are reduced least up to the rank obtained by subtracting one from the rank specified in advance in that nth-to-default credit derivative, when the risk weight of the protection provider is applied up to the notional principal amount of that credit derivative, may be deducted" as "the total expected loss amount reduced for the exposures, counting from the single exposure whose credit risk-weighted assets are reduced least up to the rank obtained by subtracting one from the rank specified in advance in that nth-to-default credit derivative, when the required capital ratio of the protection provider is applied up to the EAD of that credit derivative, may be deducted".
The expected loss amount of exposures not provided for in the preceding paragraphs shall be zero.

Where an Ultimate Designated Parent Company adopting the internal ratings-based approach, in calculating the credit risk-weighted assets of held exposures under Article 144, in the case of paragraph (2) of that Article, calculates the total amount of credit risk-weighted assets of the underlying assets, etc. of the held exposures, and those underlying assets, etc. include exposures to which the internal ratings-based approach is applied, the preceding paragraphs shall apply mutatis mutandis to the calculation of the expected loss amount of those exposures (limited to the portion equivalent to the held exposures provided in paragraph (1) of that Article).
